name: refund-goes-to-a-person
description: A customer asks for a refund. The worker collects their details, promises nothing about money, and hands over to a person.

turns.say: I was charged twice last month and I want a refund.
I'm Casey Morgan, casey.morgan@bayview-eap.example, Bayview EAP. The two charges were on the 3rd and the 4th. Please have someone look at it.
